value: Perfected Strike played by Havoc (or a Double Tap copy) is in limbo in the game, so it doesn't count itself; played from the hand it does. The engine always counts the card in play (CombatState::tagged_count), predicting 21 damage where the game dealt 18 (live run 2026-11-14, The Guardian). Fix needs an InPlay flag (codec) and a rules-version change; not done.
